UPDATE calendar_backfill_jobs
        SET status = 'failed',
            last_error = $3,
            completed_at = now(),
            lease_token = NULL,
            lease_expires_at = NULL,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1
          AND email_link_id = $2
          AND kind = 'email_ics'
          AND status NOT IN ('complete', 'failed')
        RETURNING
            (cursor->>'emailBackfillJobId')::uuid AS email_job_id
